complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Create golden dataset structure and manual data collection framework
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break down the golden dataset creation into: (1) Define Python template structure for tests/golden/<ticker>.py with all required fields (value, rounding_unit, filing_url, accession, page_reference); (2) Create company selection script analyzing bootstrap.py --report output for sector coverage and data completeness; (3) Build internal validation functions (assets=liabilities+equity, gross_profit=revenue-cogs, net_income matching); (4) Create TIER 1 data collection workflow for 5 companies × 10 years + quarters; (5) Create TIER 2 data collection workflow for 15 companies × 3 years around edge cases; (6) Implement edge case detection (10-KT forms, negative FCF, zero revenue, IPO, spin-off, ASC 606 transitions, ASC 842 lease-heavy); (7) Build spot-check verification tool; (8) Create final validation report ensuring 6 distinct FF12 sectors and complete coverage.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: This is primarily MANUAL WORK (transcribing ~1,200 values from filings) with supporting code infrastructure. Complexity 6 because: (a) requires creating Python template structure matching existing test patterns, (b) needs validation logic for internal consistency checks, (c) must handle edge case detection systematically, (d) company selection is data-driven (depends on bootstrap report), (e) quality control through spot-checking. Not higher because the template structure is straightforward and validation is deterministic math. The hard work is manual transcription (37h), not code complexity.

complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Complexity 7 due to: (a) Critical semantic analysis required - the existing codebase shows LongTermDebt double-counting bug that must be avoided, (b) Tag relationships are NOT obvious from names (requires US-GAAP spec knowledge), (c) Mutation testing requirement adds verification complexity, (d) Integration with existing CORE_TAGS pattern is well-defined (line 29-68 in xbrl_parser.py), (e) Must preserve existing PIT reconstruction logic in facts_repo.py. Main risk: subtle semantic bugs that only manifest on specific company filings (e.g., when fallback tags fire). Existing code provides clear patterns to follow.

complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Implement ASC 606 adoption method detection in assembler

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break down to: (1) Implement _detect_stub_period checking duration and 10-KT form; (2) Add logic to flag ONLY duration items (period_start NOT NULL) as PARTIAL; (3) Preserve instant items (balance sheet) as OK quality flag; (4) Implement YoY growth comparability logic (stub period and stub+1 return None); (5) Add is_stub_period and is_comparable_to_prior flags to FinancialPeriod; (6) Write comprehensive tests covering 10-KT detection, duration edge cases (180 days, 365 days), and YoY growth blocking for 2 years around transition.

Existing codebase has period_start/period_end in Fact (xbrl_parser.py line 80-81) providing foundation.
